★ Request
Show Calstone Light O (Swimsuit)

You're crazy slow whether you're walking or running,
and you dry up right away, so you're seriously not cut out for max speed.
! Congratulations to you too, Trainer!
However—I've tasted it. An excitement so intense I can't sleep.

I shall run across the water.
Pulling Trainer along inside this.

Understood! Then visualization training it is!
Haaaaaaaaaah!!
No, apparently... it's to run on water.

What shall we do next?
We have conquered sky and sea. All that remains is land.

The more I thought I should sleep, the more wide awake I became.
Because—

I don't know how to stop!!
Nuwooooooooh!!

Summer training camp had begun.
As for Calstone Light O—

The instant one foot touches the surface, lift it up
and thrust the other foot forward—repeat—!
To the sea!! Kyyyaaaaaaaaah!!
Above all—

Heh... yes!
Well? It was every bit as magnificent as the sky we saw that day, wasn't it?
—Trainer, get in.
Haaaaaaah!!

Even as the Umamusume around her started buzzing, she didn't stop her challenge.
Calstone Light O was unmistakably beginning to kick off the water's surface.

That is why you and I—
Heh... Let us live together in the realm of "top speed"!

My, I should have waved at them.
We might even have had an offshore race.

Haaaaaaah, huh, !? Guwah!!
My legs, got tangledaaaaah!!

Haa, haa, haa...! 
Hehe... haaaah~!

Through all sorts of trials, she continues striving for top speed today.
Such was that summer.
Haaaaaaaaaaah!!!!

What she pointed to as she spoke was an inflatable boat
of the kind frequently seen at swimming pools.
With top speed, we took to the sky together. In that case, next is—the sea!!
By the way, Trainer!
She did not give up.
Trainer, there is something I want to test.

Did you see that?!
Another complete victory for me to—
(Splash, splash, splash-splash-splash)

...Guess there's nothing for it but to go for it.
Just what on earth is going to happen...!

Shall we race a cheetah? Enter motorsport on foot with bare flesh?
Or... aim for the six-continent transcontinental speed record?

Light O is so pumped up~!
Maybe she'll set a new top speed record in the next race?!
Phew... haaah...!
(Gurgle gurgle gurgle...)

...Did we do it? We did it, we did it...!
We did iiit... aaah!!

Winning the Cardboard Sledding World Championship...
No, that is far too "weak."

The realm of top speed that had captivated them both.
The one charging at the very forefront wasn't alone—

Do you not wish to see it, Trainer?
The scenery at top speed.

Her leg strength as she chased top speed was immense,
seemingly unaffected by the resistance of the sand.

Why so hesitant? Scaredy-cat, wimp, isopod.
We can do all of them. I'll certainly make sure of it.
Heh, I knew you would say that.

Calstone Light O's legs struck the water with relentless power,
pounding the surface over and over—and the inflatable boat glided across the sea!

Surpass it, surpass it, I will surpass it!
Everything! I will transcend it all!!

The sun was about to set.
This was our final chance.

Running on water requires clearing several conditions.
Speed, strength, and gravity—one must transcend them all.

Forging ahead together, sharing the world.
The joy of it made her heart leap.
...To tell the truth, I couldn't sleep last night.

Gwaaaah!?
A crab!! My leg, a crab is on it—?!

Wh-What is this? Water running?!
A challenge for top speed on the ocean...!

Sand, sand, sand, saand!!
Don't think a mere nuisance like this can slow my legs down!!

There were birds.
I'm not sure what kind, but there were lots of them right along the water's surface.

Haah, haah...!
Trainer! Once more!

...It's deeply moving.
I had never even imagined it. Spending time together in the realm of top speed.
One-two, one-two, one-two-two-one, glub-glub-glub-glub!!
—Before we knew it, we had sped all the way to an unfamiliar deserted island.

Gulp, gulp... phew!
*pant*, *pant*... I'm good to go.
